::: {.lead}
These cases preserve concrete failure mechanisms and the next test that could
disprove each diagnosis. They are working research records, not examples of
the full benchmark distribution.
:::

::: {.callout-warning title="Selected development evidence only"}
This is a selected development-case library, not a prevalence estimate or leaderboard.
Repeatedly inspected cases are development evidence, never held-out validation.
No 2026 evaluation row is admissible.
Expected answers and media appear only under the recorded disclosure and rights policy.
:::

## How to read the records

**Status key:** “Selected development case” means a deliberately chosen 2025
training row that has been repeatedly inspected. It is useful for debugging a
mechanism, but cannot validate a policy or estimate how often the mechanism
occurs.

**Diagnosis key:** “Post-hoc diagnosis” means an answer-informed explanation
written after grading. It is a testable project interpretation, not a recorded
model observation or established cause. Each card therefore includes a
competing explanation and a next falsifying test.

The frozen predictions and grades below are project-generated outputs and
project adjudications. The source questions, expected answers, transcripts,
media, and source identifiers remain withheld. No case has a public-safe media
attestation, so this page is text-only.

### CASE-001 — Later-span answer selection {#case-001}

<p class="case-meta"><strong>CASE-001</strong> · Selected development case · Owner: TRECVID VQA project · Last verified: 2026-07-26 · Source/split role: 2025 training row · Theme: <a href="research-routing.{{< meta report-ext >}}#transcript-residuals">Routing, fusion, and answer selection</a></p>

::: {.case-fields}
::: {.case-field}
#### What failed

In a spoken-answer case, a brief response was followed by longer numeric
speculation. The system selected the later material instead of the needed
span.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Change tried

Automatic transcript evidence was added to the frames-only condition.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Result

Frames only predicted `2012`; frames plus automatic transcript predicted
`The horse is 22 years old.` Both were graded **wrong**. Manual accuracy,
exact match, token F1, and METEOR were all `0.0`.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Post-hoc diagnosis plus competing explanation

**Post-hoc diagnosis:** the needed span was retrieved, but a later span was
selected. A competing explanation is that the answerer preferred the longer,
more explicit numeric statement rather than later position itself.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Limit

This is one repeatedly inspected development case (`n=1`), not held-out
validation or evidence of prevalence.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Next falsifying test

Keep the evidence and answerer fixed; compare the current prompt with a
condition that masks later speculation and one that preserves it but changes
its position. The diagnosis is weakened if selection does not track the later
span.
:::
:::

### CASE-002 — Non-lexical event missed by transcript gate {#case-002}

<p class="case-meta"><strong>CASE-002</strong> · Selected development case · Owner: TRECVID VQA project · Last verified: 2026-07-26 · Source/split role: 2025 training row · Theme: <a href="research-speech-transcripts.{{< meta report-ext >}}">Speech and transcript evidence</a></p>

::: {.case-fields}
::: {.case-field}
#### What failed

The case asked the system to identify the clip's only non-lexical vocal sound.
The automatic transcript did not represent that event.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Change tried

Automatic transcript evidence was added to the frames-only condition and
passed through the old generic gate.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Result

Frames only predicted `No`; frames plus automatic transcript predicted
`Thank you for watching!` Both were graded **wrong**. Manual accuracy, exact
match, token F1, and METEOR were all `0.0`.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Post-hoc diagnosis plus competing explanation

**Post-hoc diagnosis:** the ASR missed the non-lexical event and an unrelated
phrase passed the old generic gate. A competing explanation is that the gate
was not the decisive failure because text-only ASR cannot reliably encode the
requested sound in the first place.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Limit

This is one repeatedly inspected development case (`n=1`), not held-out
validation or evidence of prevalence.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Next falsifying test

On a declared non-lexical development panel, compare the old generic text gate
with a label-blind non-lexical route and a frames-only control. The diagnosis
is weakened if rejecting unrelated transcript text does not reduce this
failure pattern.
:::
:::

### CASE-003 — Retrieved token unused by answerer {#case-003}

<p class="case-meta"><strong>CASE-003</strong> · Selected development case · Owner: TRECVID VQA project · Last verified: 2026-07-26 · Source/split role: 2025 training row · Theme: <a href="research-routing.{{< meta report-ext >}}#transcript-residuals">Routing, fusion, and answer selection</a></p>

::: {.case-fields}
::: {.case-field}
#### What failed

In a final-spoken-token extraction case, two text evidence sources contained
the needed token, but the frozen answer did not change.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Change tried

The same answerer was compared across frames-only, automatic-transcript, and
uploader-caption conditions.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Result

All three conditions predicted `Justice`. All were graded **wrong**, with
manual accuracy `0.0`.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Post-hoc diagnosis plus competing explanation

**Post-hoc diagnosis:** two text sources contained the reference token, but the
frozen answer did not change. A competing explanation is that the answerer did
not recognize the task as final-token extraction, rather than failing to use
text evidence generally.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Limit

This is one repeatedly inspected development case (`n=1`), not held-out
validation or evidence of prevalence.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Next falsifying test

Hold the two text sources and answerer fixed; compare the current prompt with
a label-blind final-token extraction instruction and a matched non-final-token
control. The diagnosis is weakened if explicit extraction does not change the
answer while the control behaves normally.
:::
:::

### CASE-004 — Unsupported native-audio specificity {#case-004}

<p class="case-meta"><strong>CASE-004</strong> · Selected development case · Owner: TRECVID VQA project · Last verified: 2026-07-26 · Source/split role: 2025 training row · Theme: <a href="research-native-audio.{{< meta report-ext >}}">Native audio and omni models</a></p>

::: {.case-fields}
::: {.case-field}
#### What failed

In a brief non-speech-event case near the end of a clip, native audio produced
an unsupported, overly specific music interpretation.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Change tried

Native audio was enabled and compared with an audio-off condition.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Result

Audio off predicted `Wedding bells`; native audio predicted
`Wedding march music.` The native-audio result was graded **Wrong**: exact
match `0.0`, token F1 `0.0`, and METEOR `0.125`.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Post-hoc diagnosis plus competing explanation

**Post-hoc diagnosis:** native audio produced an unsupported, overly specific
music interpretation. A competing explanation is that answer wording became
too specific even if the underlying sound representation improved.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Limit

This is one repeatedly inspected development case (`n=1`), not held-out
validation or evidence of prevalence.
:::

::: {.case-field}
#### Next falsifying test

Hold native audio and decoding fixed; compare the current prompt with a prompt
that requires the least-specific supported event label, plus an audio-off
control. The diagnosis is weakened if native audio remains wrong without the
specific music interpretation.
:::
:::

## Library boundary

These four selected cases are a mechanism-oriented development set. Their
count is neither a frequency estimate nor a model ranking. A future case may
be added only after its public fields are independently verified, its expected
answer remains withheld unless redistribution is attested, and any media has a
complete rights record.
